EmailTemplate.description: Email Notification to System Admin that Supplier needs to be onboarded as Portal User
EmailTemplate.name: NZC Email Notification Template for Onboarding Supplier Portal User
EmailTemplate.subject: Supplier needs to be onboarded as Portal User
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi Admin Team,
Please be informed that the Supplier record '{!Supplier.Name}' is ready to be onboarded on the Supplier Portal.
Please load the Supplier by clicking the Onboard Supplier(s) Button.
You can use the below to access the Record. {!Supplier.Link}
Thanks, Net Zero Team
